thread:
maya: Quick UX check 1 compact rules list hides the pin affordance. New users don't find 'pin to top'.
sam: Can we add a small 'Pinned' chip + hover label 'Pin rule to top'? Also surface shortcut in tooltip (Shift+P).
jordan: Agree. Add context-menu entry too for discoverability.
devin: The simulator toggle disappears when details are collapsed. Propose a sticky micro-simulator in the editor header (play/pause + last run).
aria: Accessibility: pin icon has no name in compact mode. Need aria-label="Pin rule to top" and aria-pressed.
maya: Also reorder focus so tab lands on pin before content. Improves keyboard flow.
sam: Validation copy: replace generic "Rule conflict" with "Conflicting rules detected 1 adjust priorities or pin a rule to enforce order." Add inline help link.
jordan: I'll update Figma with the badge, hover label, sticky sim, and new copy.
design-ci-bot: Figma updated: https://figma.com/file/xyz123/routing-policy-updates 1 frames 5-8 (jordan).
devin: I'll run keyboard/a11y pass once frames are ready and report back.
sam: Filing small ticket for copy + aria fixes and will post the link. :thumbsup:
